correctness.rationale: The unitary boundary-layer transformation gives the real symmetric Hankel kernel (1-(u+v)/alpha)_+^(alpha-1) without lost Jacobians; on ordered exterior powers the determinant has no factorial. The analytic mixed-coefficient valuation gives the unique Vandermonde leading term at alpha^-j(j-1)/2, while exponential Hankel tails justify Hilbert-Schmidt convergence. The scaled Laguerre Gram determinant yields exact constants; consecutive nonzero product limits imply all claimed singular ranks. The exact-rational tests verify Gram determinants, and Nyström diagnostics verify constants, but analytic proof—not finite tests—establishes the limit.

value.rationale: The entire natural low-rank approximation spectrum of high Volterra powers is quantified at every fixed rank, beginning with the first previously undetermined third rank. The factorial/4-power decay constants arise from a nontrivial Vandermonde exterior-power limit and explain successive rank compression. This is a structural rank-classification law, not a routine table lookup or arbitrarily selected parameter case.
